customers_say: Customers find the door lock easy to install, with one noting it fits perfectly on wooden door frames, and appreciate its reliable performance and triple deadlocks for high security. The lock offers multiple unlocking options and adds a modern touch to the door, while being solidly built and convenient for the whole family. The user experience receives mixed feedback, with some customers describing it as a terrible app experience.

reviews.author: Sri
reviews.title: Excellent product and highly recommended!
reviews.body: This smart door lock has truly made our lives easier! We’ve been using it for the past few months, and it’s been a great experience. No more worrying about carrying or keeping track of keys. The remote unlocking feature is very convenient, and we also receive notifications with photos of visitors who ring the doorbell. It offers great convenience and peace of mind. Excellent product and highly recommended!

reviews.author: Praveen
reviews.title: Looks promising
reviews.body: Looks good. Installed well. 1st day seems slow on bell notification.

reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.title: Great smart lock
reviews.body: Good product, value for money. Installation was smooth.

reviews.author: Az user
reviews.title: Robust and reliable
reviews.body: Got the Urban Company Native Lock Pro installed recently and so far, I’m really happy with it. The lock is quite responsive and feels solid and robust. The technician visited the very next day after the lock was delivered and completed the installation in less than an hour. The app is also simple and easy to use, which makes the overall experience quite smooth. Hopefully, it continues to perform this well in the long run. 9/10 for me so far.

reviews.author: Sree
reviews.title: Installation Service - not prompt. Product returned.
reviews.body: Installation support is poor ( was scheduled twice and no show for both occasions ) and finally had to return the item. Item build quality is okay. It runs on AA batteries. Customer support is responsive, but unable to handle their installation partners effectively.
